elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Vendor must, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided at Vendor's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day deadline runs from Customer's request, not from expiry or termination; no deadline for making that request is stated.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Vendor must return or make available all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After return or download availability, Vendor must delete Customer Data, subject to stated retention exceptions, and certify such deletion in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The obligation to provide requested transition assistance for up to six months makes assistance available for a period exceeding 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Data must be returned or made downloadable within 30 days of Customer's request, rather than within 30 days after expiry or termination.
